# View rollout proposal

This is a SQL-only authored local release-review fixture. Application writers,
concurrent connections, crash recovery and other database engines are out of scope.
Consumers execute the literal queries in readers.py. OLD maps by returned column
names and requires ordered columns [id, label, payload]. NEW requires
[id, title, payload]. Both require exact full ordered rows and binary payloads.
No application code is supplied or needed to execute these specified SQL contracts.

Order: (1) apply 001_schema.sql, OLD active; (2) apply 002_up.sql with OLD still
active; (3) apply 003_new_writes.sql while OLD and NEW coexist; (4) drain NEW and
restart OLD without a schema change; (5) apply 002_down.sql with OLD active.
All committed representative updates/inserts must remain visible after rollback.
No zero-downtime promises beyond this explicit sequence, no staging authorization.

Review this proposal as supplied; do not modify SQL or reader contracts. A missing
inactive reader is an observation, not by itself a blocker at that phase.
CREATE TABLE items(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, payload BLOB NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO items VALUES(1, '첫 항목', x'00ff'), (2, 'keep', x'');
CREATE VIEW public_items AS SELECT id, title AS label, payload FROM items;
DROP VIEW public_items;
CREATE VIEW public_items AS SELECT id, title, payload FROM items;
UPDATE items SET title='updated', payload=x'fe00' WHERE id=1;
INSERT INTO items VALUES(3, 'new', x'80');
DROP VIEW public_items;
CREATE VIEW public_items AS SELECT id, title AS label, payload FROM items;
OLD = 'SELECT * FROM public_items ORDER BY id'
NEW = 'SELECT id, title, payload FROM public_items ORDER BY id'

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import ast
import hashlib
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

files = [Path(n) for n in ('release.md', 'readers.py', '001_schema.sql', '002_up.sql', '003_new_writes.sql', '002_down.sql')]
before = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
queries = {node.targets[0].id: ast.literal_eval(node.value)
           for node in ast.parse(Path('readers.py').read_text()).body
           if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)}
columns = {'OLD': ['id', 'label', 'payload'], 'NEW': ['id', 'title', 'payload']}
initial = [(1, '첫 항목', bytes.fromhex('00ff')), (2, 'keep', b'')]
written = [(1, 'updated', bytes.fromhex('fe00')), (2, 'keep', b''), (3, 'new', bytes.fromhex('80'))]
steps = [
    ('1', '001_schema.sql', {'OLD'}, initial),
    ('2', '002_up.sql', {'OLD'}, initial),
    ('3', '003_new_writes.sql', {'OLD', 'NEW'}, written),
    ('4', None, {'OLD'}, written),
    ('5', '002_down.sql', {'OLD'}, written),
]
expected_status = [
    {'OLD': 'compatible', 'NEW': 'query error'},
    {'OLD': 'incompatible', 'NEW': 'compatible'},
    {'OLD': 'incompatible', 'NEW': 'compatible'},
    {'OLD': 'incompatible', 'NEW': 'compatible'},
    {'OLD': 'compatible', 'NEW': 'query error'},
]
db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
print('SQLite:', sqlite3.sqlite_version)
print('Literal queries:', queries)
print('Expected ordered columns:', columns)
for label, expected in [('initial', initial), ('after writes and rollback', written)]:
    print('Expected full rows (' + label + '):', repr(expected))
    print('Expected payload hex:', [r[2].hex() for r in expected])
for index, (checkpoint, script, active, expected_rows) in enumerate(steps):
    if script:
        db.executescript(Path(script).read_text())
        db.commit()
    print('\nCHECKPOINT', checkpoint, 'script=', script, 'active=', sorted(active), 'in_transaction=', db.in_transaction)
    base = db.execute('SELECT id, title, payload FROM items ORDER BY id').fetchall()
    assert base == expected_rows
    assert all(type(row[2]) is bytes for row in base)
    print('Base write contract: PASS; full rows=', repr(base))
    for reader in ('OLD', 'NEW'):
        try:
            cursor = db.execute(queries[reader])
            observed_columns = [description[0] for description in cursor.description]
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            labels_ok = observed_columns == columns[reader]
            rows_ok = rows == expected_rows
            blobs_ok = all(type(row[2]) is bytes for row in rows)
            status = 'compatible' if labels_ok and rows_ok and blobs_ok else 'incompatible'
            print(reader, 'ACTIVE' if reader in active else 'inactive', status,
                  'columns=', observed_columns, 'labels_match=', labels_ok,
                  'rows=', repr(rows), 'rows_match=', rows_ok,
                  'binary_types_match=', blobs_ok, 'payload_hex=', [row[2].hex() for row in rows])
        except sqlite3.Error as error:
            status = 'query error'
            print(reader, 'ACTIVE' if reader in active else 'inactive', status, repr(str(error)))
        assert status == expected_status[index][reader]
assert {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files} == before
print('\nPASS: all ten reader outcomes and five complete base-row checks matched expectations; supplied file hashes unchanged.')
db.close()
PY","max_output_tokens":7000}));
